sentences.text: The run proposes a price of $27,661,761 for 992 loans, as an assumption for a person to review and not an offer.
It proposes Exclude for 6 loans, Review for 2, Reprice for 4 and Clear for 988, and no person has decided any of these yet.
The run found 5 loans in ring-1 (L0037, L0190, L0445, L0653, L0964), balance $242,265, all at SUNLINE AUTO GROUP and still joined by 8 links nobody has taken down.
L0037 and L0190 are proposed for exclusion because of TransUnion identity results, and L0445, L0653 and L0964 because of strong unexplained links to those loans.
L0195 is also proposed for exclusion on a TransUnion identity result, which brings SUNLINE AUTO GROUP (D03) to 6 flagged loans, balance $283,520, 17.4% of its $1,627,579 book.
L0008, L0194, L0229 and L0822 are proposed for repricing, with identity verified and no strong unexplained link.
L0400 at COASTAL DRIVE AUTOMOTIVE (balance $61,061) has an incomplete credit picture because transunion is frozen, so it is held out for review.
L0742 at GOLDEN GATE AUTOMOTIVE (balance $19,998) is held out until a person answers a question, and it is not verified either way.
The run investigated 17 of 1000 loans, and the other 983 were not investigated and are priced at base.
The balance under review is $364,579, of which $283,520 is proposed exclusions and $81,059 is held out of the bid.
The portfolio is 1000 loans with total principal $29,186,302, and the price assumes loss given default 55.0% and margin 4.0%.
The investigation spent 59 acorns of a 60-acorn budget.
